title: International Airfare & Visa
desc: Flights to/from Nepal and Nepal tourist entry visa fees (USD 30 for 15 days, obtainable on arrival at Kathmandu Airport).

title: Mandatory Travel Insurance
desc: Comprehensive medical and travel insurance policy explicitly covering high-altitude trekking up to 4,000 m and emergency helicopter rescue.

title: Kathmandu Hotel & Meals Outside Trek
desc: Hotel nights in Kathmandu before Day 1 and after Day 7, along with lunches and dinners in the capital (available upon request).

title: Personal Trekking Equipment
desc: Personal hiking clothing, boots, and daypack. 4-season sleeping bags and down jackets are available for rent at our Kathmandu office.

title: Hot Showers in Mountain Teahouses
desc: Gas-heated hot showers at teahouses (typically cost NPR 400 to NPR 600 / approx. USD 3–$5 per shower, paid directly to lodge).

title: Wi-Fi & Device Battery Charging
desc: Airjaldi/Everest Link Wi-Fi cards and device charging fees in mountain lodges (approx. USD 2–$4 per charge, paid directly).

title: Boiled Drinking Water & Beverages
desc: Mineral bottled water, boiled drinking water, soft drinks, espresso, and alcoholic beverages. We advise water purification tablets.

title: Tipping for Guides & Porters
desc: Tips and gratuities for your trekking guide and porters (customary in Nepal, recommended USD 10–$15/day for guide, $8–$12/day for porter).

title: Flight Delays & Emergency Contingencies
desc: Extra accommodation, meals, or chartered helicopter transportation resulting from weather-related Lukla flight disruptions.

title: Personal Expenses & Souvenirs
desc: Souvenir shopping, laundry service in Namche Bazaar, trekking snacks, and incidental personal purchases.
